name: queens_n26__v5_nh
prompt:
Place 26 queens on a 26×26 chessboard such that no two queens attack each other. Queens attack along rows, columns, and diagonals.

Return a list of 26 integers where the i-th integer is the column position (0 to 25) of the queen in row i, or state "UNSATISFIABLE" if no solution exists.
